[1]

[3] Tomas Elemans explains the benefits of reading fiction. Fiction helps us understand other people's feelings and develop empathy. It also improves our imagination. Reading stories helps us understand different people and the world.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
[4] Fiction tells us something straightforward and in the meantime. And also, literary fiction can usher us into other worlds and it can make a step into other realities. According to Barack Obama, he reads fiction to think about how he understands his role as a citizen setting aside being president and he also says that the most important stuff he's learned from novels. It is a good way to learn empathy by being comfortable with the notion that the world is complicated and full of grays. Empathy is a friendly enemy to our feeling of self importance.storytelling can help us to not only understand but feel the complexity, the emotions, the situations of distance from others.Fiction enables us to know somebody in your life the more they got into the book the more their mind started tasking. We translate the here and now it reduces externally focussed attention there by increasing deeper reflection. To conclude, fiction can help us to disconnect from ourselves and tap into an emotional and prosthetic side that we don’t often take the time to explore.                                                                                                                       
[5] In this video, Thomas Elemens talks about the importance of reading fiction. Today, we read a lot of news, emails, and other information every day. Many people choose nonfiction books because they can learn useful information from them. However, fiction books also have many benefits. Elemens explains that reading fiction helps us understand other people’s feelings and situations. For example, he talks about a novel about a mother who travels to Alaska with her children. At first, he did not like the main character. However, as he continued reading, he started to understand her feelings and became very emotional. This experience helped him understand how fiction can develop empathy. He also introduces Barack Obama’s opinion. Obama said that reading novels helped him understand his role as a citizen and learn about empathy. Elemens explains that fiction allows us to imagine other people’s lives and think about situations that are different from our own. Finally, he says that reading fiction can help us think more deeply and become less focused on ourselves. Fiction does not give us easy answers, but it helps us understand the world and connect with other people.

Opinions

five sample opinions

[1] I found this speech interesting because it made me realize that reading fiction is not just a way to enjoy stories. It can also help us understand people whose lives and experiences are different from our own. I especially agree with the idea that literature develops empathy by allowing us to imagine other people's feelings and perspectives. In today's world, we often judge others based on limited information, especially on social media. Reading fiction may help us look beyond these quick judgments. However, I think empathy should not end with reading. We also need to listen to people around us and communicate with those who have different opinions. I believe that combining imagination with real-life experiences can help us become more understanding and open-minded.
[2] I agree with his opinion that we are exposed to excessive information and books help us relieve our stress and improve imagination. However I do not necessarily think that fiction is essential to our lives. I like reading but I do not read fiction that much because we can develop our imagination even without reading books of fiction. For example,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
[3] Throughout watching this video, I thought that I should increase the amount of reading. I usually read literary fiction too so I make sense of the word “empathy”. But I have never thought about reading for action. So I should read books more to gain the benefits of reading.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
[4]
